# Outcome

`jiangyun-fun/sam-tagger` is now a production-ready GitHub repo — license,
pixi-based CI, tag-triggered release automation, Dependabot, settings, topics
— and release **v3.0.0** is published with sdist + wheel. Plan:
[20260805-094118_setup-github-repo.plan.qmd](./20260805-094118_setup-github-repo.plan.qmd).

| Commit / tag | Change |
|---|---|
| `ca6728f ci:` | CI/release workflows, dependabot, LICENSE, repo metadata |
| `9450d88 fix(ci):` | commit `pixi.lock` (cache-key fix) |
| `v3.0.0` (tag) | first release (sdist + wheel) |

# What was set up

- **LICENSE** — MIT (matches `pyproject.toml`).
- **`pyproject.toml`** — `readme = "README.md"`, `[project.urls]` (Homepage/Repository/Issues).
- **`pixi.toml`** — `build` task (`python -m build`) + `build` dev dep.
- **`README.md`** — CI / release / license / python badges.
- **`.github/workflows/ci.yml`** — one job `ci`; pixi-based gate
  (`lint`/`typecheck`/`test` via `-e dev`); `prefix-dev/setup-pixi@v0.10.0`;
  trigger on `main` push + PR.
- **`.github/workflows/release.yml`** — on `v*.*.*` tag (+ `workflow_dispatch`),
  build sdist+wheel and attach to a (create-if-missing) GitHub release.
- **`.github/dependabot.yml`** — `github-actions` ecosystem, weekly, grouped.
- **Settings** — squash-only, `delete_branch_on_merge=true`, projects off (wiki off),
  description set; **kept private** per user.
- **Topics** — amplicon, bam, bioinformatics, cyclopts, minimap2, pysam, qc, sam.
- **Release v3.0.0** — curated notes + `sam_tagger-3.0.0-py3-none-any.whl`
  + `sam-tagger-3.0.0.tar.gz`.

# Verification (evidence)

- **CI green** — run `30967572496` (`ci`, 33s): checkout → `setup-pixi` →
  `pixi run -e dev lint` → `typecheck` → `test`, all ✓.
- **Release green** — run `30967697840` (`release`, 36s): build sdist+wheel ✓,
  attach to release ✓.
- **Release live** — <https://github.com/jiangyun-fun/sam-tagger/releases/tag/v3.0.0>
  with both assets.
- **Local build** — `pixi run -e dev build` → `dist/` with both artifacts; the
  wheel bundles all 13 modules + `entry_points.txt` + LICENSE. `python -m build`
  uses build isolation and does **not** import the package, so the conda-only
  `pysam` is not needed at build time (the inputs a conda recipe consumes).
- **Gate (pre-commit)** — `pixi run -e dev lint && typecheck && test` →
  **126 passed**, 0 type errors, lint clean.
- **Settings/topics** — confirmed via `gh api` / `gh repo edit`.

# Deviations from plan (and why)

- **Committed `pixi.lock`** — the plan said "respect the gitignore"; reality
  overrode it. `setup-pixi@v0.10.0` with `cache: true` errored
  *"Failed to generate cache key"* on the first CI run (`30967486824`, failed in
  13s): the cache key is hashed from `pixi.lock`, which was gitignored
  (untracked). Committed the lock (pixi best practice for CI — reproducible solve
  + working cache key); `.gitignore` now ignores only `.pixi/`. Fixed in `9450d88`.
- **`setup-pixi@v0.10.0`, not `@v3`.** The skill examples don't cover setup-pixi;
  `@v3` does not exist. Verified latest tag via `gh api repos/prefix-dev/setup-pixi`
  → `v0.10.0`. Dependabot keeps it current.
- **Dependabot = `github-actions` only.** Native `pip`-ecosystem Dependabot on
  `pyproject.toml` would bump PyPI deps out of lockstep with `pixi.toml`
  (`pysam` is conda-only). Rationale documented inline in the config.

# Out of scope / follow-ups

- **Branch protection** — skipped (private repo; needs public or GitHub Pro).
  Revisit when the repo goes public.
- **Make repo public** — deferred by the user ("after some preparation"). The
  release/tag become public automatically at that point.
- **Dependabot PR #1** (`actions/checkout` 4→7) is open; its CI failed only
  because it predates the lock commit — a re-run/merge will pass and also
  silences the Node.js 20 deprecation annotation on `checkout@v4`.
- **Conda package** — user will build separately; the sdist + wheel are the
  inputs.
